name: HD Rendering
author: Machine Hunter Workshop
description: Renders the world at up to 640x480 instead of its original 320x240, with real extra detail; menus, briefings and the in-game interface keep the original layout, scaled up. Shows the picture in a window of any size or fullscreen, kept 4:3 or stretched, sharp or smooth.

options.label: Render resolution
options.help: How much detail the world is drawn with. 320x240 is the original game; 640x480 is as far as the game's renderer goes. A change takes effect the next time the game starts.

options.label: Shape
options.help: Keep 4:3 shows the picture as the game was made, with black bars on a wider screen.

options.label: Scaling
options.help: Sharp keeps the pixels crisp, Smooth blends them, Whole pixels scales only by 2x, 3x and so on, leaving a border where the screen is not an exact fit.

options.label: Display
options.help: Fullscreen fills the monitor the game is on, without changing the screen's resolution.

options.label: Fullscreen key
options.help: Switches between a window and fullscreen.

options.label: Window size
options.help: The size the window opens at; it can also be resized and maximized. A size bigger than the screen becomes the largest that fits.
